verdict.rationale: The evidence documents ID-to-selfie matching and only a generic statement that Stripe's programmatic systems detect fraudulent verifications. Nothing names a defense against AI-generated faces, deepfakes or camera-injection attacks, and the story explicitly excludes generic fraud mentions. Biometric anti-spoofing is a fair question for an identity-verification product, so the absence of evidence makes this "none", not "na".

support.subject: As a risk analyst, the vendor documents specific defenses against AI-generated faces, deepfakes, and camera-injection attacks — named detection capabilities, not just a marketing mention of fraud
